items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1969-12-14
items.q: tell Johnny and Steve Allen that I didn't mean any harm to them, because I like Johnny. I have played with Johnny a long time

ctx.x: Mr. Chance, we thank you for calling. We have to go into what we call a station break here.

Thank you very much. Well, I'm sorry, because I really like to, I have a lot of condensals to prove what I have said and tell Johnny and Steve Allen that I didn't mean any harm to them, because I like Johnny. I have played with Johnny a long time, and he's a wonderful trumpet player. I just wanted to get that straight about that jazz proposition, because there's too many people trying to claim it. It's only claimed by the boys, just like Johnny said. Johnny's correct. They thought they would hate the band, but…
Right, so everybody will go away friends except Mr. Allen, who you called Steve. It's Dick. Thank you for calling.
